mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a tightening monetary cycle amid high inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when either CPIAUCSL or FEDFUNDS rises alone without the other, or SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of joint signal instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1500 thousand units) and robust consumer spending (RSAFS > 360,000 million dollars), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days due to sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting both HOUST and RSAFS thresholds, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when either HOUST or RSAFS declines alone without the other, or SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of joint decline instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days as monetary tightening suppresses growth and equity valuations.
regime_hint: high inflation and high rate regime
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS thresholds, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 5-year windows.
